name: caol.patrol_sound_focused_mcw
description: Focused patrol sound preference proof on a disposable prepared camp. The fixture and incidental setup have zero credit; native duty, UI, qualified sound response, release and reload carry the observation.

steps.label: observe_patrol_sound_duty
steps.objective: Using advertised native actions, establish each personal Investigate sounds starting value, enter actual patrol duty, observe effective rule and a qualified unseen audible event, and compare release. Exercise loop and hold and native save/reload where the scene permits; distinguish setup from observed NPC behavior.
proof_targets: same actor and personal rule before duty for OFF and ON starts
native priority assignment and actual loop and hold runtime ownership
native effective rule UI while duty is active with personal preference preserved
qualified audible event outside the guard sight and observed NPC response, with actual danger and reachability conditions
native duty release and revealed personal rule for each starting value
native save/quit and reload of same actor and duty state
invariants: fixture Patrol zone and practical scene preparation have zero gameplay credit
only native actions and independent observations establish NPC perception, movement, rule state and elapsed time
danger, sound priority, visibility, reachability and zone filters remain operative; ON does not guarantee investigation
do not modify NPC state or saves, fabricate sound perception or action, inject receipts, or credit bootstrap
preserve both starting values and distinguish loop from hold and each duty exit
keep actual failures and limitations distinct from qualification and claim acceptance

steps.label: observe_patrol_sound_after_reload
steps.objective: Observe the same actor after native save and process replacement; verify the effective duty setting and personal preference, then complete any remaining native sound, duty-exit and restoration observations.
proof_targets: same actor and actual patrol runtime after reload
effective rule during duty and personal rule after native duty exit
qualified sound and observed response where still required
invariants: do not reinstall the fixture or directly edit NPCs or saves
preserve actual duty, sound and release observations without inventing prior stages
